title: Two Men in Lounge, 1970s B&W Photograph
description: A candid black and white photograph from around 1970 capturing two men in a lounge or waiting area. One man sits in an armchair engrossed in reading a newspaper, while the other stands confidently in a vest and suit jacket, smiling at the camera. A bilingual sign ('EXIT / SORTIE') visible near the doorway suggests a location in Canada or an international facility.
